Name: Kent Marriage  of StarDerg Valley graphic extensions mod
Author: Rexlino1332
Description:
我为 Kent Marriage 添加了 StarDerg Valley 图形扩展名，因为缺少文件 Characters 和 Portraits 使其难以阅读。只需将文件直接移动到 Mod 中即可。为防止冲突，删除源文件的图像可能会导致一条错误消息，指出找不到该文件，但可以正常读取该文件。通常情况下不会有影响，如果有影响记得留言通知或者修改文件名。
Kent Marriage的StarDerg Valley图形扩展，因为缺少Characters和Portraits文件容易读取不到，所以我添加了。直接把文件里面的移到mod里面就好了。以防冲突，把源文件的图片给删除，会报错，找不到文件，但是会正常读取。通常情况下不会有影响，如果有影响记得留言通知或者修改文件名。
有人说留言读取不了，所以我添加了替换名称的图片。你可以尝试把MACOSX删除并把文件添加到Kent marriage mod里面，这两个文件是相同的，不过图片格式不一样，有可能读取不到或者被覆盖了。我对造成不便深感抱歉，如果有影响记得留言通知。
I added the StarDerg Valley graphic extension to Kent Marriage because the missing files Characters and Portraits make it difficult to read. Just move the file directly to the Mod. To prevent conflicts, deleting the image of the source file may result in an error message stating that the file cannot be found but can be read normally. There won't be any impact.
You can try deleting MACOSX and adding the file to Kent marriage mod. These two files are the same, but the image format is different, which may result in unreadable or overwritten images
I am deeply sorry for any inconvenience caused. If there is any impact, please remember to leave a message for notification.
